title: ANZ Terminals Pty Ltd proposed acquisition of GrainCorp Liquid Terminals Australia Pty Ltd
targets: GrainCorp Liquid Terminals Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties in response to the Statement of Issues.
Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's decision (31/10/2019) is delayed to allow the ACCC further time to consider information received.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to a section 87B undertaking accepted by the ACCC.
